summary: Kenny has Eren and Historia. Levi's squad takes the Reeves company, and pain is used as a tool to make the interior speak.

segments.ja: ケニーとの遭遇のあと、街には弾の跡が残ります。残った跡を、リヴァイは追うより先に生存者を数えます。数は、昨日の班より少ないです。少ない班で、エレンとヒストリアの行方を探します。探す材料は、リーブス商会の馬車です。馬車を押さえたジャンたちは、商人を敵と味方のあいだに置きます。置かれた商人は、中央に二人を売ろうとしていました。売ろうとした理由は、まだ金だけではありません。金の下に、中央の圧力があります。
segments.en: After the meeting with Kenny, bullet marks remain in the city. Before chasing the marks that remain, Levi counts the living. The count is smaller than yesterday's squad. With the smaller squad, they search for where Eren and Historia went. The material of the search is the Reeves company's wagon. Jean and the others, having seized the wagon, set the merchant between enemy and ally. The merchant who was set there had been about to sell the two to the interior. The reason he was about to sell them is not money alone yet. Under the money is the interior's pressure.

tokens.note: Kenny Ackerman. He leads the interior squad that hunts Eren and Historia, and he once raised Levi.

segments.ja: リーブスは、街の物資が止まれば人が死ぬと言います。言う論理は、調査兵団の正義より自分の帳簿です。帳簿を、リヴァイは否定せず、しかし二人を返せと置きます。置いた条件は、中央への通路を教えることです。教える側に、息子のフレーゲルはまだ立っていません。立っていない息子を、父は危険の外に置こうとします。置こうとする親心が、今日はまだ決断になりません。決断は、息子が後で引き受けるものです。
segments.en: Reeves says people die if the city's supplies stop. The logic he states is his own ledger, more than the Survey Corps' justice. Levi does not deny the ledger, but he sets down that the two must be returned. The condition he sets is to teach the path toward the interior. Flegel, the son, is not yet standing on the teaching side. The father tries to put the son who is not standing outside the danger. The parental feeling that tries does not yet become a decision today. The decision is one the son will take later.

segments.ja: 中央が人から秘密を抜く方法は、痛みです。痛みを、サネスは秩序の技術として信じています。信じている技術を、ハンジとリヴァイは逆に使います。使う場所は、捕らえた憲兵の部屋です。部屋で、質問は爪と光と時間で作られます。作られた質問に、サネスは最初は笑い、あとで崩れます。崩れるまでが、この回の題です。題は、相手を理解するためではなく、壁の王を特定するためです。特定が、今日の本当の目的です。
segments.en: The interior's method of pulling a secret out of a person is pain. Sannes believes in pain as a technique of order. Hange and Levi use the technique he believes in, in reverse. The place they use it is the room of a captured military policeman. In the room, questions are made of nails, light, and time. Sannes laughs at the questions that were made, at first, and later he breaks. Until he breaks is the title of this episode. The title is not in order to understand the opponent. It is in order to identify the king of the walls. Identification is today's real purpose.

segments.ja: サネスが守ってきたのは、壁の中の平穏です。平穏のために、彼は何度も口を塞いできました。塞いだ記憶を、彼は正義として語ります。語る正義は、調査兵団の死者を見ません。見ない正義を、ハンジは自分の怒りと分けて聞きます。分けて聞いても、爪の記憶はニックと重なります。重なった記憶が、質問の手を止めません。止めない手が、ついに王の名に触れます。
segments.en: What Sannes has protected is peace inside the walls. For that peace, he has shut mouths many times. He tells the memory of shutting them as justice. The justice he tells does not look at the Survey Corps' dead. Hange listens to the justice that does not look, separate from her own anger. Even listening separately, the memory of nails overlaps Nick. The overlapped memory does not stop the hand of the question. The hand that does not stop finally touches the king's name.

segments.ja: 出てきた名は、フリッツではなくレイスです。レイス家が、壁の本当の王家に近い、とサネスは崩れながら置きます。置いた情報は、まだ洞窟の中身までは届きません。届かない情報でも、ヒストリアが狙われる理由が太くなります。太くなった理由を、エルヴィンはクーデターの材料にします。材料は、痛みで買ったものです。買ったものを、彼は道徳では磨きません。磨かない顔が、団長の今日です。
segments.en: The name that comes out is not Fritz. It is Reiss. Sannes, while breaking, sets down that the Reiss family is close to the true royal house of the walls. The information he sets does not yet reach what is inside a cave. Even information that does not reach makes the reason Historia is targeted thicker. Erwin makes the thickened reason into material for a coup. The material was bought with pain. He does not polish what was bought with morality. The face that does not polish is the Commander today.

segments.ja: 一方、エレンは見えない部屋に繋がれています。繋がれた隣に、ヒストリアがいます。いる二人は、なぜ自分が必要かをまだ聞きません。聞かない暗闇で、エレンは硬質化の失敗を繰り返して思います。思う失敗が、ここに連れてこられた理由かもしれません。かもしれない不安を、ヒストリアは役の笑顔では隠しません。隠さないことが、二人のあいだのわずかな信頼です。信頼は、まだ脱出には足りません。
segments.en: Meanwhile Eren is chained in a room he cannot see. Historia is beside where he is chained. The two who are there have not yet heard why they are needed. In the dark where they do not hear, Eren keeps thinking about the failure of hardening. The failure he thinks about may be the reason he was brought here. Historia does not hide the anxiety that it may be so with the smile of a role. Not hiding it is a small trust between the two. The trust is not yet enough for an escape.

segments.ja: ケニーの隊は、対人の立体機動と銃を持っています。持っている隊は、調査兵団の巨人殺しとは別の狩人です。狩人の目的は、二人をロッド・レイスの側へ運ぶことです。運ぶ途中で、彼らはリヴァイの班を街の影に見ます。見るたびに、弾が先に出ます。先に出る武器を、ミカサは刃で受け止めきれません。受け止めきれない距離が、この戦いの痛みです。痛みは、肉だけでなく、仲間の名前です。
segments.en: Kenny's squad has anti-personnel ODM gear and guns. The squad that has them is a different kind of hunter from the Survey Corps' Titan killers. The hunters' purpose is to carry the two toward Rod Reiss. On the way of carrying, they see Levi's squad in the city's shadow. Each time they see it, bullets come out first. Mikasa cannot fully receive the weapon that comes out first with a blade. The distance she cannot fully receive is the pain of this fight. The pain is not only flesh. It is the names of comrades.

segments.en: Armin's disguise is a role meant to delay the enemy's confirmation. Jean supports the role with his own body while hating it. The reason he supports it is time to keep Eren away from the real cage. The time is short, and the humiliation is long. He swallows the long humiliation as the squad's work. Connie covers the face that swallows it with a laugh. Even covered, if the sound of guns comes back the laugh ends. Each time it ends, they put survival first.

segments.en: The Commander is, on the surface, close to house arrest. In that close state, he waits for the movements of Pyxis and Zachary. During the wait, the report of pain arrives from Levi. The report that arrives is that Reiss is the king. He makes the report that is so into the core of a coup. The core is not yet in the city's newspapers. Flegel will later take the role of making the core that is not out public. Before that happens, today is still the room of torture.

segments.ja: リヴァイは、ケニーの銃の癖を体で覚えています。覚えている癖が、今日の回避を可能にします。可能にした回避は、勝ちではありません。勝ちではない再会を、彼は感情では処理しません。処理しない代わりに、次にどこを撃つかだけを見ます。見る目は、子供のころの依存を拒みます。拒んでも、相手の名を呼ばないわけにはいきません。呼ばない沈黙が、痛みのもう一つの形です。
segments.en: Levi remembers the habit of Kenny's gun in his body. The habit he remembers makes today's evasion possible. The evasion it made possible is not a win. He does not process the reunion that is not a win with feeling. Instead of processing it, he only looks at where the next shot will go. The eyes that look refuse the dependence of childhood. Even refusing, he cannot avoid calling the opponent's name. The silence that does not call is another shape of pain.
